07 / Questions, answered

Buying a new car.

How should I compare on-road prices?

Choose the same variant and city, then compare the ex-showroom price, registration, insurance and optional extras separately. KERB shows an itemised estimate in each vehicle dossier.

Are the waiting periods city-specific?

The catalogue contains model-wide estimates. City-specific dealer delivery data is unavailable; confirm a delivery commitment with your chosen dealer.

What is included in the EMI estimate?

The estimate uses your selected budget and tenure, 20% down payment and 9.5% annual interest. Actual lending rates and fees depend on your lender.

Are upcoming launch dates confirmed?

The watchlist contains unverified catalogue estimates. Confirm launch dates, final specifications and booking availability with the manufacturer.
